title: Keep the waiting session machine relay running
when: Before ending a turn while CI continues.
need: In local, self-hosted and hosted modes, run yoke relay status on the session machine and repair its named refusal. Keep that machine awake and connected; on Linux stay logged in with linger disabled.
surface: Public GitHub CI wake-up guidance linked from verification and Linux relay docs.
review: Relay observer and machine routing inspected; Linux no-linger contract checked in source. No cross-mode live wake proof claimed.
